  agent_failure_modes:

      description: If the Orchestrator constructs an invalid URL or chooses a search query that yields no results, WebSurfer cannot recover the original path.
      severity: 0.90
      if_from_agent_wrong: The task becomes impossible to complete as the specific archived page is inaccessible via the chosen method.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: WebSurfer will execute the command but return no useful data, forcing the task to terminate without the answer.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: The Orchestrator might repeatedly issue similar commands (e.g., different variations of the same failed search) without recognizing the pattern of failure.
      severity: 0.65
      if_from_agent_wrong: WebSurfer will continue to fail in the same manner, preventing the discovery of alternative sources.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The agent will be stuck in a cycle of ineffective actions.
